sections.heading: INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: The rehabilitation of the Alupotha main road connecting the market junction to the Grama Sevaka Office remains a priority for our administration.

sections.heading: CIVIC SERVICES
sections.text: We will improve access to government services, reduce processing times at the Divisional Secretariat, and establish a digital service counter at the Grama Sevaka Office by the end of the first year.

sections.heading: YOUTH EMPLOYMENT
sections.text: A vocational training fund will be established to support young people in trades and technical education.

lines.text: Section 1 is about the road. It promises repair 'as a priority.' You have read the manifesto. Most people do not.

lines.prompt: You have read it. There is still an unmarked box in the corner.
